title: x402 Extension Spec — auth-hints
quote: The `auth-hints` extension provides authentication hints for specific payment requirements within x402. ... For example, a `deferred` payment requirement uses off-chain vouchers against an escrow deposit, so the server needs to verify the client's identity to match vouchers to the correct escrow account and track accumulated value. Without this extension, the client has no way to know which `accepts[]` entries require authentication until it tries and gets rejected.

title: x402 Extension Spec — payment-identifier (idempotency key)
quote: The `payment-identifier` extension enables clients to provide an `id` that serves as an idempotency key. Both resource servers and facilitators consume `PaymentPayload`, so this can be leveraged at either or both points in the stack to deduplicate requests and return cached responses for repeated submissions. ... Later requests with the same `id` and a different fingerprint should fail with `409 Conflict` instead of reusing the cached response or executing a second operation.
